data.name: Aijul
data.gender_notes: Aijul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aijul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Aisvarya' which means 'God's compassion'. It is a name of Lord Vishnu and is believed to bring blessings of kindness, mercy, and grace. The name Aijul carries the meaning “God's compassion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Aijul usually hope their child will grow to embody god's compassion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Name of Lord Vishnu symbolizing divine compassion and grace.
data.etymology: Aijul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's compassion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aijul total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aijul has roots in Hinduism, one of the world's oldest and most influential cultures. The name reflects the rich cultural heritage of ancient India, where Gods and their attributes held significant meaning in people's lives. Aijul being a name of Lord Vishnu creates a deep connection to this revered deity and the values he represents.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu philosophy, Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, is revered for his compassionate nature. The name Aijul signifies the divine bestowal of God's grace upon the bearer. It is a reminder that no matter what life may bring, the mercy and compassion of Lord Vishnu are always present. The spiritual significance of this name is a powerful inspiration for those seeking inner peace, kindness, and a stronger connection to the divine.

historical_references.reference: Aijul was a famous Jaina Tirthankara, also known as Adinath or Rishabhdev. He is believed to have lived around 500 BC.
Aijul was also a legendary king of the Vatsa kingdom, who ruled around 300 BC. He is remembered for his wisdom and just rule.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Aijul' is of Hindu origin and translates to 'God of love'. In the modern context, this name is used in various ways across three popular platforms: Instagram, Pinterest, and Blogger. On Pinterest, boards and pins with this name are dedicated to spirituality and meditation practices. Lastly, on Blogger, there are several fashion blogs named 'Aijul' featuring Indian clothing and accessories.
